    • Method Detail

      • renderTauPlot

        public static BufferedImage renderTauPlot(double[] x,
                                          double[] y,
                                          CalculateTau.CalculateTauResult result,
                                          boolean fitFailed,
                                          int width,
                                          int height)
        Renders a Tau plot with the given data points, the fitted curve (if available), axes, labels, and annotation text.
        Parameters:
        x - the x-coordinates of the data points
        y - the y-coordinates of the data points
        result - the Tau-fit result, including Tau and R²
        fitFailed - true if the exponential fit failed
        width - image width in pixels
        height - image height in pixels
        Returns:
        a BufferedImage containing the rendered plot

      • exportBackgroundHistogramsToPngs

        public static void exportBackgroundHistogramsToPngs(Experiment experiment,
                                                    Path experimentPath)
                                             throws IOException
        Exports a background-track histogram for each recording as a PNG file:

        Output/Background Plots/.png

        Parameters:
        experiment - the experiment containing the recordings
        experimentPath - the experiment root path
        Throws:
        IOException - if image output fails

      • saveTauFitPlot

        public static void saveTauFitPlot(List<Track> tracks,
                                  CalculateTau.CalculateTauResult tauResult,
                                  Path experimentPath,
                                  String recordingName,
                                  int squareIndex)
        Saves a Tau-fit plot (successful or failed) for the given square. Output is stored as: Output/Tau-Fitting Plots/Success/<...>.png Output/Tau-Fitting Plots/Failed/<...>.png

        The output directory tree is created automatically.

        Parameters:
        tracks - the tracks used in Tau fitting
        tauResult - the Tau fitting result (may indicate failure)
        experimentPath - the root path of the experiment
        recordingName - the recording name
        squareIndex - the square index (used in file naming)
